outcome: 17 Claude skills and 6 prompt kits built for traders (plan, bot audit, account stats, watchlist scan, research, earnings plans, Pine Script, content tools), plus the Milli MCP link that puts 30 trading playbooks inside Claude or ChatGPT.
setupTime: 2 minutes for the MCP link; 5 minutes to install every skill
whoFor: Traders who use AI and want repeatable, honest workflows
Anyone building or running a trading bot
Traders who post their results online
prerequisites: A Claude or ChatGPT account (paid plan for connectors)
Claude Code for the skills that run scripts (optional)
costNote: Everything here is included. Claude, ChatGPT and data providers are billed by them; free tiers work for most skills.
quickStart: Add https://milli-ai.com/api/mcp as a connector and ask 'Milli: list your playbooks'.
Run /trading-plan me, then /bot-audit on any bot before it goes live.

changelog.note: First release: 17 skills, 6 prompt kits, 30 MCP playbooks.
